text:
I created a 15-second ad for CapCut with Seedance 2 inside @capcutapp from just a simple prompt:

A funny ad commercial for CapCut, showing a stressed video editor battling monsters that come out of his laptop, and CapCut comes to the rescue. Multiple shots, Pixar animation style https://t.co/aMK6QC4NYa
content: A funny ad commercial for CapCut, showing a stressed video editor battling monsters that come out of his laptop, and CapCut comes to the rescue. Multiple shots, Pixar animation style

translations.es: Un anuncio divertido para CapCut, mostrando a un editor de video estresado luchando contra monstruos que salen de su laptop, y CapCut viene al rescate. Múltiples tomas, estilo de animación de Pixar.
translations.fr: Une publicité humoristique pour CapCut, montrant un monteur vidéo stressé combattant des monstres qui sortent de son ordinateur portable, et CapCut vient à la rescousse. Plusieurs prises de vue, style d'animation Pixar.
translations.ja:
---
CapCutの面白い広告コマーシャル。ストレスを抱えたビデオエディターが、ラップトップから出てくるモンスターと戦っているところに、CapCutが救いの手を差し伸べる。複数のショット、ピクサーアニメーションスタイル。
translations.ko:
---
스트레스받는 비디오 편집자가 노트북에서 튀어나오는 몬스터들과 싸우는 재미있는 CapCut 광고. CapCut이 구원자로 등장합니다. 여러 장면, 픽사 애니메이션 스타일
---
translations.pt-BR: Um comercial engraçado para o CapCut, mostrando um editor de vídeo estressado lutando contra monstros que saem do seu laptop, e o CapCut vem ao resgate. Várias cenas, estilo de animação da Pixar.
translations.zh-CN: 一则有趣的CapCut广告，展示了一位紧张的视频编辑与从他笔记本电脑中冒出来的怪物作斗争，而CapCut前来拯救。多镜头，皮克斯动画风格。
